verdict.rationale: TeamViewer documents a Web API at webapi.teamviewer.com/api/v1/docs, but nothing shows a downloadable machine-readable spec. Human-readable API docs are an adjacent capability and earn no credit for this story. Probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404, so the evidence does not establish the capability.
